courses.title: Brand Messaging That Resonates
courses.description: By the end of Brand Messaging That Resonates, you'll be able to apply brand messaging confidently in Communications Specialist work, with a working sense of where analytics for content fits alongside it. The course moves from core brand messaging technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at analytics for content woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying brand messaging to a real Communications Specialist scenario
Practicing brand messaging through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to analytics for content
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Crisis Communication for Practitioners
courses.description: Crisis Communication for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of crisis communication, for people already working toward a Communications Specialist role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in crisis communication and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying crisis communication to a real Communications Specialist scenario
Practicing crisis communication through guided exercises
Building a short crisis communication exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Brand Messaging Essentials
alternates.description: Brand Messaging Essentials is a short introduction to brand messaging for people moving toward a Communications Specialist role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show brand messaging in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if brand messaging is new to you.
learning_outcomes: Applying brand messaging to a real Communications Specialist scenario
Practicing brand messaging through guided exercises
Building a short brand messaging exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Brand Messaging Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Brand Messaging Techniques is a focused course on brand messaging for people already working toward a Communications Specialist role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying brand messaging on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying brand messaging to a real Communications Specialist scenario
Practicing brand messaging through guided exercises
Building a short brand messaging exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
